mapper.sql:
SELECT skill.id, 'SKILL' AS type, skill.name AS technicalKey, skill.display_name AS displayName, skill.description, skill.status, skill_version.id AS latestPublishedVersionId, skill_version.version_no AS latestPublishedVersionNo, skill.created_at AS createdAt, skill.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM skill LEFT JOIN skill_version ON skill_version.skill_id = skill.id AND skill_version.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM skill_version newer WHERE newer.skill_id = skill_version.skill_id AND newer.status = 1 AND newer.version_no > skill_version.version_no ) WHERE skill.deleted = 0 AND skill.scope_type = 'SYSTEM' AND skill.space_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT agent_template.id, 'AGENT_TEMPLATE' AS type, agent_template.name AS technicalKey, agent_template.display_name AS displayName, agent_template.description, agent_template.status, agent_template_version.id AS latestPublishedVersionId, agent_template_version.version_no AS latestPublishedVersionNo, agent_template.created_at AS createdAt, agent_template.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM agent_template LEFT JOIN agent_template_version ON agent_template_version.template_id = agent_template.id AND agent_template_version.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_template_version newer WHERE newer.template_id = agent_template_version.template_id AND newer.status = 1 AND newer.version_no > agent_template_version.version_no ) WHERE agent_template.deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT mcp_template.id, 'MCP_TEMPLATE' AS type, mcp_template.server_key AS technicalKey, mcp_template.display_name AS displayName, mcp_template.description, mcp_template.status, mcp_template_version.id AS latestPublishedVersionId, mcp_template_version.version_no AS latestPublishedVersionNo, mcp_template.created_at AS createdAt, mcp_template.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM mcp_template LEFT JOIN mcp_template_version ON mcp_template_version.template_id = mcp_template.id AND mcp_template_version.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM mcp_template_version newer WHERE newer.template_id = mcp_template_version.template_id AND newer.status = 1 AND newer.version_no > mcp_template_version.version_no ) WHERE mcp_template.deleted = 0

where.if: capability.status = 1 AND capability.latestPublishedVersionId IS NOT NULL
AND ( capability.technicalKey LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR capability.displayName LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR capability.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select:
SELECT capability.* FROM () capability
ORDER BY capability.updatedAt DESC, capability.id DESC, capability.type LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT 'SKILL' AS type, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(skill.status = 1), 0) AS enabledCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM skill_version published_version INNER JOIN skill system_skill ON system_skill.id = published_version.skill_id WHERE published_version.status = 1 AND system_skill.deleted = 0 AND system_skill.scope_type = 'SYSTEM' AND system_skill.space_id IS NULL) AS publishedVersionCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM space_skill_installation) AS installationCount FROM skill WHERE skill.deleted = 0 AND skill.scope_type = 'SYSTEM' AND skill.space_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'AGENT_TEMPLATE' AS type, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(agent_template.status = 1), 0) AS enabledCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent_template_version published_version INNER JOIN agent_template system_template ON system_template.id = published_version.template_id WHERE published_version.status = 1 AND system_template.deleted = 0) AS publishedVersionCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM agent WHERE deleted = 0 AND template_id IS NOT NULL) AS installationCount FROM agent_template WHERE agent_template.deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'MCP_TEMPLATE' AS type, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(mcp_template.status = 1), 0) AS enabledCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mcp_template_version published_version INNER JOIN mcp_template system_template ON system_template.id = published_version.template_id WHERE published_version.status = 1 AND system_template.deleted = 0) AS publishedVersionCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mcp_server WHERE deleted = 0 AND template_id IS NOT NULL) AS installationCount FROM mcp_template WHERE mcp_template.deleted = 0
